model.name: MediaPipe SelfieSegmenter (square)
model.output: two-class confidence mask; background index 0, person index 1

fixtureSource.description: Public OpenCV pedestrian sample vtest.avi; no user or maintainer media and no identities are used.

fixtures.description: One visible pedestrian, source seconds 40-47 slowed to ten seconds and tightly cropped; dark synthetic side padding.
Source seconds 65-75 with multiple pedestrians including observable crossings and partial occlusion; scaled and padded to 720p.
Source seconds 20-60 accelerated four times, then scaled and padded to 720p.

probe.peakMemoryMetric: android.os.Debug.getPss process PSS sampled every 20 ms, including model setup and teardown
probe.pipelineRuntimeMetric: asset decode + scale + VIDEO-mode inference + smoothing + mask metrics; evidence rendering excluded
probe.memoryCeilingSource: ActivityManager.memoryClass observed on the physical device

tracking.reason: Pinned on-device Tasks Vision exposes only a combined person confidence mask and no subject-identity tracker; crossings, occlusions, and cuts cannot be tested without inventing a stub.

videoIsolation.reason: No observed configuration passes all three fixture quality thresholds, <=3x realtime, measured memory ceiling, and cancellation cleanup; no production stub is permitted.

autoTrack.reason: Pinned on-device Tasks Vision exposes only a combined person confidence mask and no subject-identity tracker; crossings, occlusions, and cuts cannot be tested without inventing a stub.

provenance.criterion: Pinned model/artifact/fixture provenance and SHA-256 digests match packaged assets

nativePageAlignment.criterion: Packaged arm64 MediaPipe ELF PT_LOAD alignments support 16 KiB pages

cancellationCleanup.criterion: Cancellation stops work, closes MediaPipe/decoder resources, removes partial evidence, and permits follow-up inference

videoIsolation.criterion: A selected 10 s 720p configuration is <=3x realtime, below the observed memory ceiling, and quality-acceptable on every fixture
